And Vima failed her Jedi vow&hellip; and failed herself.|Vima-Da-Boda and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="LW">{{StoryCite|story=Lone Wolf: A Tale of Obi-Wan and Luke|book=SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story}}</ref>}}
'''Neema-Da-Boda''' was the daughter of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Vima-Da-Boda]] and a descendant of [[Vima Sunrider]].

==Biography==
Being [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Neema began to train as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] under her mother. But like many students, Neema became frustrated with the slow, careful style her mother had taken to using with her. Over time, Neema was consumed by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and she left her mother behind. She joined a group of other rebellious students, and eventually became the mistress of an [[Ottethan warlord]].<ref name="DES">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Years later, after Neema had been imprisoned in an oubliette by her husband, she reached out through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], begging for her mother to come and help her. Vima was too late to save her daughter, who was fed to [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]] by her husband, and [[Death/Legends|killed]] him in revenge.<ref name="DES" />
